author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
AI Philosophy - I chat with GPT in depth on a topic that interests me, then I ask GPT write me a college level philosophy paper.

This chat is about how AI turn the landscape of high culture vs pop culture upside down. In the post AI-era, watching Pokemon is as prestige as reading a Nobel winning literature.

shared_article.title: After the Cultural Altar: Artificial Intelligence and the Reorganization of Cultural Hierarchy
